style: Read this aloud as an excited, genuinely enthusiastic presenter showing a friend a product they truly love: upbeat and energetic, a big smile in the voice, natural human rhythm with real emphasis, little lifts of delight and varied pitch, like a great product demo by a real person. Lively, quick pace. Never flat, monotone or robotic, never shouting, never salesy. Say only the words below.

lines: Okay, here's the whole platform, recorded live in the real app. Let's go!
This is AI Autopilot, and it runs all of your businesses at once! Every project gets its own business workspace, with its own goal, workflows, prospects and website.
And each one handles its own social media, email marketing, text messages, blog posts and bookings. It all runs on the server, every five minutes, even with this page closed.
Your AI Live Business Manager watches every campaign. Look, forty-six emails went out, and nobody replied.
So it flags it: this campaign isn’t getting replies, and here’s exactly what it would change.
One click, and AI re-optimises it, in the business’s own voice!
And nothing changes until you approve it.
Or just talk it through in the live chat. It asks about your business, and suggests what to try.
AI Prospecting! Just say who you sell to, in one sentence.
It searches live, reads every website, and checks each address before you send a thing.
Websites and funnels for every client, built and hosted right inside the app.
Start from a whole site, not a blank page, and make it totally yours.
And now, everything else, at full speed!
The Unified Inbox! Connect all your mailboxes, your text messages and your website chat, and every conversation lands in one place.
The urgent ones come first, and a ready reply is one click away.
Contacts, scored and segmented, with a list for every business workspace that AI keeps filling with new leads.
Pipelines! Someone asks for a quote on the website, and seconds later it’s a deal on the board. Nobody typed a thing.
Email campaigns and sequences from your own mailbox, with real open and reply numbers, and they stop the moment someone answers.
And here’s your social media on autopilot: AI agents write posts, articles and emails for each business, on a schedule, and every piece waits for your yes.
Need graphics for those posts? Pick a template, say what it’s about, and it’s designed in your client’s brand, in every format.
SEO blogging, too. It learns how the business writes, builds a keyword strategy, and plans a whole month of posts.
Booking pages that fill your calendar, in your own look, with times shown in each visitor’s time zone.
Put an AI chat agent on any website with one line of code. It answers from what you publish, and hands over to a person.
Running an agency? White-label the whole app: your product name everywhere, and your own sign-in address for your clients, live at once.
And reports, read live from every module: where your contacts came from, deals by stage, and whether your mail is arriving.
That’s Protected Central. One platform, every business, run by AI. Come and see it for yourself!
